item.tib: ma rgyud mkha' 'gro dgongs pa 'dus gsang ba ye shes chen mo yi sku bsgrub snang ba'i 'od gur
item.coloph: ces mkha' 'gro gsang ba ye shes kyi sku sgrub snang ba'i 'od gur 'di ni/ shar phyogs rnam dag bkod pa'i mkha' 'gro 'dus gnas nyi ma rang shar gyi ke'u tshangs su (tshang du) / rigs ldan karma du tra bde ba'i spos can gyi grogs dan dang bcas/ gsang bdag 'ja' tshon snying pos kun gzhi rgya mtsho g.yo med kyi klong nas/ dran rig gis (gi) na bun bkag med 'thul ba bzhin yi ger bkod pa me 'brug zla tshes la dge'o//
